description: This is a Python source file implementing the AimGuardrail class, which integrates with Aim Security Guardrails to analyze and potentially block or anonymize LLM calls based on security policies. It includes methods for pre-call hooks, moderation hooks, output analysis, and streaming responses, as well as error handling and configuration.
